result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide roadway with embedded streetcar tracks and a complete lack of marked crossings. Sidewalks are present but narrow, lack a buffer from traffic, and are obstructed by utility poles, creating a high-stress environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any designated or protected crossing points, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic and tracks without guidance.

hazards.name: Embedded streetcar tracks
hazards.description: Tracks in the roadway create significant tripping hazards for pedestrians and can trap bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located within the narrow sidewalk, reducing the effective clear width for pedestrians and those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to provide a clear path around utility poles and repair cracked pavement to ensure ADA compliance.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane roadway with embedded rail tracks and a midblock marked crosswalk. While a sidewalk and green space are present on the far side, the long, unprotected crossing distance across several lanes of traffic creates a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four travel lanes and two sets of rail tracks without a refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no physical protection or waiting area for pedestrians in the middle of this wide crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at this midblock crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the faded transverse markings to a high-visibility continental pattern.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a narrow sidewalk on one side of a wide roadway that contains embedded tram tracks. There are no marked crossings or pedestrian refuge areas, resulting in a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians. Sightlines are partially obscured by parked vehicles, and utility poles obstruct the already limited sidewalk width.

hazards.name: Tram Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can cause tripping for pedestrians and are a significant hazard for cyclists.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The lack of marked crosswalks or refuge islands on a wide street increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles located in the middle of the narrow sidewalk reduce the effective clear width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly delineate pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

result.summary: The image shows a mid-block urban street with a continuous concrete sidewalk directly adjacent to the roadway. The environment lacks pedestrian safety enhancements such as street trees, buffers, or marked crossings, and the walkway is partially obstructed by debris and vegetation.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large blue barrel is placed in the middle of the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking width.

hazards.name: Trip Hazards
hazards.description: Overgrown weeds and uneven joints in the concrete sidewalk slabs.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk joints and curb line

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: No physical separation, such as trees or a furniture zone, between the sidewalk and the travel lane.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Remove debris and weeds, and repair uneven sidewalk slabs to ensure a clear and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lamps to improve visibility and security for pedestrians during nighttime hours.
